description: This file contains implementations of various RNN and LSTM cell functions, including milstm_cell, lstm_cell, flat_lstm_cell, premul_lstm_cell, premul_lstm_cell_no_bias, gru_cell, rnn_relu_cell, and rnn_tanh_cell, utilizing PyTorch tensors.

methods.name: milstm_cell
methods.description: Implements a modified LSTM cell with additional parameters alpha, beta_i, beta_h, and bias.

methods.name: lstm_cell
methods.description: Standard LSTM cell implementation with input, hidden state, and bias parameters.

methods.name: flat_lstm_cell
methods.description: LSTM cell variant with precomputed gates inputs.

methods.name: premul_lstm_cell
methods.description: LSTM cell with precomputed input gates, combining them with hidden state.

methods.name: premul_lstm_cell_no_bias
methods.description: LSTM cell without bias terms, with precomputed input gates.
